derivation: For 0<k<H with exactly one visit, unit height increments force every earlier height below k and every later height above k. Hence consecutive such visits occur in increasing height order and delimit strict positive bridges. A height between consecutive cuts has all its visits inside that segment and cannot have exactly one visit, so each is visited at least twice.
